# Pixel Gallery Modal

A responsive, offline browser app featuring a gallery of 6 CSS-drawn tiles. Click any tile to open it in a modal with title, Previous/Next navigation, and close via Escape or Close button.

## Features
- 6 unique CSS-drawn tiles (no external assets)
- Modal with enlarged tile and title
- Previous/Next buttons inside modal
- Keyboard accessible: Tab navigation, Escape to close, Arrow keys to navigate
- Focus trap in modal and focus return to triggering tile
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with accent colors

## How to Use
1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click a tile to open the modal.
3. Use Previous/Next buttons or Left/Right arrow keys to navigate.
4. Close with the Close button, Escape key, or clicking outside the modal.

## Files
- `index.html` – main structure
- `styles.css` – all styling and CSS-drawn tiles
- `script.js` – gallery generation and modal logic

## Constraints
- No external libraries, network requests, or server code.
- Pure HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.
- All graphics drawn with CSS.
- Keyboard-accessible controls with ARIA labels.

## Testing
- Verified at 360px width and above.
- All interactions tested: click, keyboard, modal open/close, prev/next.
- No external dependencies.
